Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules associated with document CHEMBL1145073. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno for chembl_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles (only include rows where canonical_smiles is present). Take compound_name from compound_records. Return distinct rows over the three output columns. Sort by chembl_id, then compound_name, then canonical_smiles.
